struttura.title: The Apartment
struttura.subtitle: A private apartment in the heart of Corato
struttura.description: A Due Passi Da is a 70 m² private apartment at Via Duomo 81 in the historic center of Corato (BA). With a double bedroom, a single bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room, it accommodates up to 4–5 guests. It is ideal for families and small groups who want to experience Puglia with the comfort of a private home.
highlights: Private apartment with its own entrance
struttura.accessibilityNotice: Upper floors are accessible only by stairs. There is no elevator.

attractions.title: Surroundings
attractions.subtitle: Discover the wonders of Puglia from Corato

items.name: Bari
items.description: The old city with the seafront and the Basilica of San Nicola. Perfect for a day between history and cuisine.

items.name: Trani
items.description: The white cathedral on the sea, the port and the Swabian castle. A gem of the Adriatic coast.

items.name: Castel del Monte
items.description: UNESCO heritage, the enigmatic octagonal castle of Frederick II. A medieval masterpiece.

items.name: Alberobello
items.description: The famous trulli, conical houses UNESCO heritage. A unique village in the world.

items.name: Polignano a Mare
items.description: Breathtaking beaches, cliffs overlooking the sea and the famous Lama Monachile.

items.text: Delightful apartment in the heart of the historic center. Clean, welcoming and perfect for our family. Antonio was very kind!

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in is flexible. Contact us to arrange a convenient time. Check-out is usually by 11:00 AM.

items.question: Is breakfast included?
items.answer: We provide a coffee machine and pods free of charge. For any other breakfast needs, please contact the host.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes. Private parking is available by reservation for €20 per day.

items.question: Is there an elevator?
items.answer: Upper floors are accessible only by stairs. There is no elevator.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi free?
items.answer: Yes. Free high-speed Wi-Fi (135 Mbps) is available throughout the property.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: Please contact us to discuss bringing a pet.

items.question: How do I get there from the train station or airport?
items.answer: Corato train station is 700 m away (a 10-minute walk). We offer a shuttle from Bari Airport (42 km away) on request.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Fill out the quote form or contact us by email or WhatsApp. We will reply within 24 hours with availability and prices.

items.question: Is the apartment suitable for families?
items.answer: Yes. The apartment is spacious enough for families. A crib for infants is available on request from the host.
